customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be of good quality, with positive feedback about its installation, taste, and water quality. The reliability receives mixed reviews - while some say it works as new, others report that filters stop working after a year. The durability is concerning, with customers noting it won't last more than a year. The water wastage aspect is also mixed, with some praising its zero-wastage feature while others consider it a gimmick.

reviews.title: Don’t use KENT
reviews.body: Strong Review Very bad product and extremely disappointing service from KENT. I purchased this product just 3 months ago, and unfortunately, I received a defective product. There was no proper replacement option from either Amazon or KENT. Since then, I have had to call for service more than 5 times within just 3 months. The product was supposed to be reliable, but it has become a constant headache.
